title: BAYESIAN MOD MACHINE LEARNING
description: Basic statistics and machine learning strongly recommended. Bayesian approaches to machine learning. Topics include mixed-membership models, latent factor models, Bayesian nonparametric methods, probit classification, hidden Markov models, Gaussian mixture models, model learning with mean-field variational inference, scalable inference for Big Data. Applications include image processing, topic modeling, collaborative filtering and recommendation systems
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Basic calculus, linear algebra, probability, and programming.
